sku_type.notes: For new PH coffee rows, sub_brand is the specific product line without repeating brand; pack_type and banded both hold the numeric listing pack count. Preserve explicit Original/Multi Variant values when supported. Ground sub_brand, weight, flavor, and the category levels from the title, image, Shopee attributes, and closest same-form sibling rows; do not copy a merely token-similar product. Some legacy rows use a different layout and leave sub_brand/pack_type empty, so legacy NULLs are not a requirement to fill or a blocker.

keywords.notes: keywords equals sku_type when keywords_typo is empty; otherwise prefix the grounded typo/alias. Do not invent a typo.

non_generated_columns.cat_lev_2: Ground from observed vocabulary and the product form; common values are Beans, Powder, Capsules, RTD, and Other.
non_generated_columns.cat_lev_3: Ground from observed vocabulary and a same-form sibling, such as Roasted Beans, Instant Pure, Instant 2 in 1, Instant 3 in 1, Capsule, Ready to Drink, or Other.
non_generated_columns.banded: Numeric pack count; for new rows keep it equal to pack_type.
non_generated_columns.pack_type: Numeric pack count used by the current new-row format. Legacy rows may be NULL.
